skills.detail:
When the enemy has an undefended Treasure Area:
Moves to the undefended enemy Treasure Area which is furthest from the user.

When the enemy has no undefended Treasure Areas:
Effect that increases own SPD. Nullifies Stagger for a set period of time. This skill cannot be used in certain areas that have obstacles overhead. There is a cooldown in effect for a set period of time at the start of battle.
skills.name: DOM Shoes

skills.detail: Moves towards enemies at long-range and attacks multiple times, pushing them back. Plus, a long-range area attack with a Knockback effect. Damage dealt will change based on the enemies' HP. This will deal a fixed percentage of damage and will not increase due to a critical hit. Nullifies Stagger for a set period of time. Acquires SPD debuff effect at Level 5.
